cases.expected_stdout_text:
Usage: ls [-aAdF1RCxmrtucSbqNQ] [-w WIDTH] [-T TABSIZE] [-H|-L|-P] [FILE...]
      --help      display this help and exit
      --version   display version and exit
  -C lists down columns; -x across rows; -m uses commas; -1 uses lines.
  -w, --width=COLS sets line width (0 unlimited); -T, --tabsize=COLS sets tabs.
  -b escapes names; -N is literal; -Q uses C quotes; -q replaces control bytes.
      --quoting-style=STYLE selects GNU C-locale quoting.
      --show-control-chars displays remaining control bytes.
      --color=always,never controls explicit type/extension colors.
  Active su/sg/ex/ca/mh or tw/ow/st colors require unavailable metadata.
  -H follows command-line links; -L follows all links; -P follows none (extension).
  -u, -c and --time select and imply time sorting unless -S or -t selects a sort.
  -S requires regular files; metadata-rich long listing is not supported.
